response.sql: WITH country_averages AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country) SELECT country, avg_points, avg_wins, avg_wins - AVG(avg_wins) OVER () AS wins_vs_country_average FROM country_averages ORDER BY country;
